en.t: The facts are a little different, aren't they?

units.source_text: 记得在节日晚上，他认错了人，是说要送腰带给千重子小姐的嘛。”

en.t: If I remember correctly, on the night of the festival he mistook someone for someone else, and said he wanted to give Miss Chieko an obi.”
Naeko paused for a moment, then went on, “

units.source_text: 那位腰带铺的人，织腰带的人好像非常倾慕你呀。

en.t: That man from the obi shop, the one who weaves obi, seems to admire you very much.

units.source_text: 我毕竟是个女孩子，懂得这点。”

en.t: After all, I am a girl, so I understand that much.”
